description: This Java class defines MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages by passing only the message content, omitting metadata like priority, tag, or Throwable, and forwards the message to the next LogNode in the chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter LogNode that forwards only log messages, excluding other metadata, to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain if provided.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only include the message text and sends it to the next LogNode.
